title: Maven
explain: Maven builds a Java project from a `pom.xml` that lists its dependencies and settings. `mvn package` compiles, tests and packs your code into a jar, and dependencies download from Maven Central automatically. The standard folders are `src/main/java` for code and `src/test/java` for tests.
exercise: Create the standard folder layout, add one class and one test, and run `mvn package`.
tip: Older Maven versions need `maven-surefire-plugin` 2.22 or newer declared before JUnit 5 tests will run. Check your version with `mvn -v`.
